business_summary: Yixintang Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiary, engages in the pharmaceutical retail chain and pharmaceutical distribution business. The company is involved in the wholesale, retail, leasing, and operation of medical devices; sale of food, disinfectants, disinfection equipment, and disposable medical products, household appliances, adult toys, agricultural and sideline products, cosmetics, and daily sundries and necessities; manufacturing of glasses; provision of value-added telecommunications, Internet live broadcast technology, and Internet information services for medicines, as well as clinic and foot bath services; operation of aquatic wild animals and call center; retail of publications; and decoction services for Chinese herbal medicines. It also engages in the agency sale of single-purpose commercial prepaid cards and China sports lottery; and maternal and child care activities. In addition, the company provides health care, housekeeping, amusement park, residents' daily life, and health consulting service, as well as business agency, ticket agency, personal Internet live broadcast, remote health management, corporate member points management, food delivery, and road freight transportation services. Further, it is involved in the import and export of goods and technology; wholesale of pet food and supplies; and wholesale of clothing and accessories. Additionally, the company sells products online. The company was formerly known as Yunnan Hongxiang Yixintang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yixintang Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. in June 2019. Yixintang Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kunming, China.
business_summary_ko: Yixintang Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 의약품 소매 체인 및 의약품 유통 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 의료기기의 도매, 소매, 임대 및 운영에 참여하고 있습니다. 식품, 소독제, 소독기구, 일회용 의료용품, 가전제품, 성인용 장난감, 농수산물, 부업용품, 화장품, 생활잡화 및 생필품 판매 안경 제조; 부가통신, 인터넷 생방송 기술, 의약품 인터넷 정보 서비스, 진료소 및 족욕 서비스 제공; 수산야생동물 및 콜센터 운영 출판물 소매; 한약재 달임 ​​서비스 등을 제공합니다. 또한, 단일 목적 상업 선불 카드 및 중국 스포츠 복권의 대행 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 그리고 엄마와 아이 돌보기 활동. 이 밖에도 헬스케어, 살림, 놀이공원, 주민생활, 건강컨설팅 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 사업대행, 티켓 대행, 개인 인터넷 라이브 방송, 원격 건강 관리, 기업 회원 포인트 관리, 푸드 드링크 등의 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
